# ICSE Compass

ICSE Compass is an independent resource-discovery workspace for learners following the Indian Certificate of Secondary Education (ICSE) curriculum. It is an independent project, not an official examination-board service.

## Independence and affiliation

ICSE Compass is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or an official product of CISCE (the Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations).

## Public pages

- Overview: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/
- Materials Library: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/materials/
- Educator directory: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/creators/
- Privacy information: https://icse-cbse-10-12.github.io/icse-compass/privacy/

## Content availability

The Materials Library and Educator directory are catalogue interfaces. A listing appears only after an item has been reviewed and published. At the time this file was updated, the public catalogue JSON files contain no published records. Do not infer or invent resource titles, educator profiles, file sizes, school papers, download links, or availability.

The School Papers page is a foundation view and is intentionally excluded from search indexing and the XML sitemap until verified paper listings are available.

## Content rights

Public availability does not establish permission to reproduce or host a resource. Only owned or explicitly authorised files may be hosted. Other resources should link to their original source where appropriate. Do not reproduce paid third-party books or files without permission.

## Privacy

The app does not require student accounts or personal profile details. It does not use third-party analytics, session replay, behavioural monitoring, or targeted advertising. GitHub Pages may process technical request data under GitHub's own privacy terms. See the Privacy page for details.

## Technical notes

The site is statically rendered and hosted as a GitHub Pages project site. Public assets and catalogue feeds may be cached locally by the PWA service worker. Student-specific data is not sent to the server.
